description: MCP23017 16-channel I2C GPIO expander breakout (Waveshare style)

i2c.address_select: A0/A1/A2 strap pins select one of eight addresses. Two expanders on one bus is fine; two at 0x20 is not.

interrupt.note: The interrupt output must land on an RTC-capable pin if it has to wake the MCU from deep sleep. On ESP32-S3 that means GPIO0-21.

keepouts.reason: Screw terminals or headers occupy one long edge and need wire entry room.

traps: This part is the standard escape hatch when a board has no free ADC1 channel and a resistor-ladder keypad is therefore impossible. It is also 38 x 23 mm, which is large: adopting it grew one reference enclosure from 105 x 72 mm to 110 x 76 mm. One pin decision moved the enclosure by 5 mm on two axes.

It carries onboard 10k I2C pull-ups. Stack three such modules on one bus and the effective pull-up drops to about 3.3k, which can be too stiff at 3.3 V. Count the pull-ups already fitted before adding your own.
notes: Use it for buttons, LEDs and any slow digital I/O. Do not put a bus-timed signal behind it.
Choosing the expander is an ARCHITECTURAL fix for PIN_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, not a patch. It changes the BOM, the power budget and the enclosure.
